name: run_frame

test_list.description: A real model stream requesting tools is authorized before execution; the returned CAS-backed result is replayed on the next model request with the exact provider call id.
Verifier rejection consumes a step and retries no more than the configured retry count, with total attempts also bounded by frame quota.
Repeated tool-call turns stop before a model invocation beyond the configured tool-round limit.
Cancellation during a provider stream returns Cancelled and does not refund reserved model tokens or the step attempt.
Malformed streams that finish as Stop with tool calls, or ToolCalls without any calls, fail before authorization or execution.
Accepted verifier CIDs are recorded against the reserved step; rejected and claimed-done outcomes do not add diff history.
Tool result CIDs remain attached to the exact model-issued call identity as the transcript is carried across bounded steps.
A tool result whose model-visible content does not hash to its declared content CID is rejected before verifier acceptance or replay.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: Active frame owning capability, step and token quota ledgers.

inputs.name: maximum_attempts
inputs.description: Hard ceiling on model/tool/verifier attempts for this run.

inputs.name: maximum_retries
inputs.description: Hard ceiling on retries after verifier rejection.

inputs.name: maximum_tool_rounds
inputs.description: Hard ceiling on tool-bearing model turns.

output_description: The terminal or bounded continuation outcome, attempt counts, and tool results, or the first typed policy/backend/protocol/cancellation error.
